request:
Which internal httpx modules are imported directly by both httpx/_client.py and httpx/_models.py? Give the repository-relative file paths of the imported modules.

Requested output columns: file_path (string).
explanation: Finds internal files imported by both httpx/_client.py and httpx/_models.py by grouping file_dependencies on the imported file and keeping those with two distinct importers among the pair.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT d.imported_file_id AS file_path FROM code.file_dependencies d WHERE d.importer_file_id IN ('httpx/_client.py', 'httpx/_models.py') GROUP BY d.imported_file_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.importer_file_id) = 2 ORDER BY file_path
